title: Handley Page Halifax LW115
memorial_details: A stone wall with central black marble tablet carrying the names, one at the left with squadron crest and a drawing of a Halifax bomber on the right hand tablet.
inscription: In Memory Of / THOSE WHO DIED WHEN A HALIFAX BOMBER OF NO.433 Sqdn. / ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE / CRASHED AT LONAN ON 14TH JULY 1944 / SOME WRECKAGE FELL ON A HOUSE "HOKANG" PINFOLD HILL / FATALLY INJURING A CHILD. / Crew / (names) Canadian flag each side of the crew names Across the edge of the step 1914 - 18 THEIR NAME LIVETH FOR EVERMORE 1939 - 45
community_connection: A Child Was Fatally Injured When Some Wreckage Fell On A House 'Hokang' Pinfold Hill.
